description: Delete one of this shop's listings for good; ask the seller to confirm first, or use set_listing_status hidden to take it down for now. While the shop or listing is under review it is hidden instead. Returns `deleted`, `hidden`, `reason` and `message`; a second call for a deleted listing answers `not_found`.

id.description: The listing to delete for good (its id, from list_listings or get_listing); read it with get_listing first, since a deletion cannot be undone

name: delete_listing

deleted.description: true when the listing was deleted; false when it was hidden instead

hidden.description: true when it was hidden instead of deleted because the shop or listing is under review; false when it was deleted

message.description: A sentence to show the seller, saying why it was hidden and when it can be deleted; null when it was deleted

reason.description: Why it was hidden instead. account_held or account_suspended: the account is under review. open_report: a report about it or the shop is still open. null when it was deleted

title: Delete shop listing
